M3_insert.label: M3 x 5 x 4
M3_insert.source: User-confirmed existing stock; supplied package drawing
M3_insert.bore_note: The shared 4.6 mm pilot is the printed hole, not the insert outside diameter. The existing project convention provides 0.4 mm nominal diametral interference; the supplied label does not specify a recommended pilot.

regular_D5.use: Regular Obi-Wan and preserved LM connections

crescent_D6.use: Crescent UM and matching upper wing connections; eight discs per assembly

digital_wall_gate.continuity_basis: In the seated-disc working region, the cavity-facing wall footprints must form one connected component and overlap the prior model layer across at least half their area. This is a project screening criterion, not a measured bond-strength claim.
digital_wall_gate.basis: Arachne minimum is 85% of 0.52 mm outer width; upper bound is two 0.6 mm nozzle diameters. D6 inclined 0.82 mm skins do not use the thinner D5 single-traversal width limit. Physical print confirmation remains mandatory.

exceptions.reason: Existing print pose and D5 roof contract; no PLA is loaded or required. Fail if support extrusion exists.
Curved replacement wings have different geometry. GF supports with PLA contact; cavity blockers must exclude trapped support.
Disable critical-only and small-overhang removal so the entire 44.6 mm cap ceiling receives three full PLA contact layers.
Nonprinting modifier above installed Y=421 mm overrides UM 100% with tweeter 15% gyroid.
Bottom contact retains 0.18 mm gap and 0.5 mm spacing. It is not equivalent to the dense zero-gap top contact; review if supports are allowed to start on model surfaces.
Local 100% bridge-root modifier remains as an explicit structural safeguard; redundant with current global 100%.
Block only functional bore and route volumes. Check actual support bead intersection, not blocker count or colour.
Report sub-half-layer PLA contact at the mouth separately from support inside the cylindrical bore; retain a numerical bound and witness.
Digital boundary, width and loading checks plus a same-geometry coupon are necessary; extrusion, insertion, pause bonding and retention require a physical print.
